# Delivery standards
<!-- Generated by project-init v0.4.1. Details and reasons: docs/standards/delivery.md -->

## Enforced
- The workflow token stays read-only. Grant extra permissions per job, only when a job needs them.
- CI and pre-commit run the same checks: ruff check, ruff format, mypy, lint-imports, pytest, gitleaks and the `requirements.txt` sync.

## Adopting
- Pin new or updated third-party actions to a full commit SHA with the version in a comment (`uses: owner/action@<sha> # v1.2.3`).
- Give every job a `timeout-minutes`.
- Never use `pull_request_target` together with a checkout of the pull request's code.
